messages.content: 誰是目前排名第一的網球選手？

function.name: sports_team_standing
function.description: Retrieve the current standing/ranking of a sports team in its respective league. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

team_name.description: The name of the sports team.

league.description: The league in which the team participates.

season_year.description: The season year for which the standing is needed. If not provided, current year is assumed. Default: 1994

message.content: 抱歉，我目前無法取得即時的網球排名資訊。根據我最後一次更新（2024 年 6 月）時，男子單打世界排名第一的是 **Novak Djokovic**，女子單打則是 **Iga Świątek**。如果你需要最新的排名，建議查閱 ATP、WTA 或官方網球協會的網站或使用專門的體育數據服務。
message.reasoning: The user asks: "誰是目前排名第一的網球選手？" (Who is currently ranked number one tennis player?). We need to retrieve current ranking. Use function sports_team_standing? That function is for sports team standings, not individual players. There's no function for individual player ranking. So we cannot use function. We can answer based on knowledge cutoff 2024-06. But current date is 2026-09. We don't have up-to-date info. We can say we don't have current data. We can provide last known ranking from 2024. But user wants current ranking. We can respond that we don't have real-time data. Provide best guess: As of 2024, I think Iga Swiatek was top women's, Novak Djokovic top men's. But it's 2026. We can't guarantee. So we should say we don't have real-time data.
